items.title: Artificial Intelligence Applied to Epigenomic Data in Leukemia: A Systematic Review of Diagnostic, Prognostic and Monitoring Models
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Epigenetic deregulation is a defining feature of leukemia, and DNA methylation and chromatin accessibility profiles encode the cell of origin, lineage and clinical behaviour of the disease. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) can extract predictive patterns from these high-dimensional data, but the published models have not been systematically appraised. We systematically reviewed AI models built on epigenomic data in leukemia for diagnosis, prognosis, relapse and treatment-response prediction, and measurable residual disease (MRD) detection. Methods: This review followed PRISMA 2020 and the SWiM guideline. PubMed was searched on 7 October 2026 with three structured queries, supplemented by a broader PubMed query, citation searching and web searching. Eligible studies were peer-reviewed primary studies that applied an ML or deep-learning algorithm to DNA methylation, chromatin-accessibility or histone-modification data from human leukemia samples and reported a quantitative diagnostic, prognostic, response or MRD outcome. Risk of bias and applicability were assessed with PROBAST, informed by PROBAST+AI. Owing to heterogeneity, results were synthesized narratively and in structured tables, without meta-analysis. Results: Of 68 unique database records and 32 reports from other sources, 30 studies (2010-2026; 22 since 2020) were included: 16 in acute myeloid leukemia, 4 in acute lymphoblastic leukemia, 2 spanning acute leukemia lineages, 3 in juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia and 5 in chronic lymphocytic leukemia; 10 were pediatric. DNA methylation was the input in 28 studies and chromatin accessibility in 2; no eligible study modelled histone marks. Tree ensembles (n = 9) and support vector machines (n = 5) were the most frequent algorithms. Diagnostic classifiers reported accuracy, concordance or F1 scores of 0.87-1.00, and two classifiers were applied to nanopore sequencing data, one returning acute leukemia subtype calls within about 2 hours. Prognostic epigenomic scores were associated with survival (reported hazard ratios 2.36-10.82), but discrimination fell on transport to independent cohorts (C-index 0.677 internally vs 0.529 in one external cohort). Fifteen studies validated models on an external epigenomic cohort, one prospectively. Overall risk of bias was high in 21 studies, unclear in 8 and low in 1, driven by the analysis domain (small samples, absent calibration, possible data leakage). Calibration was reported in 3 studies and code was available for 11. Conclusions: Epigenomic AI models classify leukemia subtypes with high reported accuracy and can deliver same-day diagnoses, and methylation-based scores add prognostic information. However, the evidence is dominated by retrospective, high-risk-of-bias development studies with limited external validation and almost no prospective or impact evaluation. Prospective, multi-center validation with calibrated, transparently reported models is required before clinical adoption.
items.summary_zh: 预印本系统综述了白血病表观基因组 AI 模型在诊断、预后、复发、治疗反应和微小残留病灶检测中的证据，纳入30项研究并系统评估偏倚。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它集中揭示了表观基因组模型从高报告准确率到临床可迁移性之间的落差：多数研究偏倚风险高，外部验证、校准和前瞻性影响评估不足，因此不能把关联性预后信号视为临床因果或可用性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：表观遗传失调是白血病的定义性特征，DNA 甲基化和染色质可及性谱编码了细胞起源、谱系和疾病临床行为的信息。人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）可以从这些高维数据中提取预测模式，但既有模型尚未得到系统评价。我们系统综述了基于白血病表观基因组数据构建的 AI 模型，这些模型用于诊断、预后、复发和治疗反应预测，以及可测量残留病灶（MRD）检测。方法：本综述遵循 PRISMA 2020 和 SWiM 指南。PubMed 检索于 2026 年 10 月 7 日进行，采用三条结构化检索式，并补充更宽泛的 PubMed 检索式、引文追踪和网络检索。纳入标准为：在人类白血病样本的 DNA 甲基化、染色质可及性或组蛋白修饰数据上应用 ML 或深度学习算法，并报告定量诊断、预后、反应或 MRD 结局的同行评议原始研究。偏倚风险和适用性依据 PROBAST、并参考 PROBAST+AI 进行评估。由于研究异质性，结果采用叙述性综述和结构化表格综合，未进行荟萃分析。结果：在68条独特数据库记录和其他来源的32份报告中，共纳入30项研究（2010—2026 年；其中22项发表于 2020 年以后）：急性髓系白血病16项、急性淋巴细胞白血病4项、跨急性白血病谱系2项、幼年型粒单核细胞白血病3项、慢性淋巴细胞白血病5项；其中10项为儿科研究。28项研究以 DNA 甲基化为输入，2项以染色质可及性为输入，没有符合条件的研究对组蛋白标记建模。树集成模型（n = 9）和支持向量机（n = 5）是最常用算法。诊断分类器报告的准确率、一致性或 F1 分数为 0.87—1.00；其中两个分类器应用于纳米孔测序数据，一个可在约2小时内给出急性白血病亚型判定。表观基因组预后评分与生存相关（报告的风险比为 2.36—10.82），但迁移至独立队列后区分度下降（一个外部队列中，内部 C-index 为 0.677，外部为 0.529）。15项研究在外部表观基因组队列上验证模型，其中1项为前瞻性验证。总体偏倚风险在21项研究中较高，8项不明确，仅1项较低；主要问题来自分析领域，包括样本量小、缺少校准和可能的数据泄漏。仅3项研究报告了校准，11项提供了代码。结论：表观基因组 AI 模型可以以较高报告准确率对白血病亚型进行分类，并可能实现当日诊断；基于甲基化的评分也可增加预后信息。然而，现有证据主要来自回顾性、高偏倚风险的模型开发研究，外部验证有限，几乎没有前瞻性或临床影响评估。在临床采用前，需要开展前瞻性、多中心验证，并使用经过校准且透明报告的模型。

items.title: DECONVersation: Single Cell Foundation Model-Derived Embeddings for Robust Cell Type Deconvolution of Bulk RNA-seq
items.abstract_or_text: AI and deep learning have transformed single-cell transcriptomics, empowering unsupervised annotation, trajectory inference, and cross-dataset integration at scale. Here, we propose bulk RNA-seq deconvolution as a novel task for single-cell foundation models. Deconvolution estimates cell type proportions from bulk RNA-seq using single-cell reference data, with applications spanning tumor microenvironment profiling to the detection of disease-associated shifts in tissue composition. However, existing methods remain vulnerable to batch effects, subject-level variation, and marker gene selection sensitivity. We introduce DECONVersation, which leverages embeddings from pretrained and fine-tuned single-cell foundation models, coupled with a non-negative least squares solver, to estimate cell type proportions. Foundation model embeddings are robust to batch effects and implicitly encode complex gene relationships, sidestepping explicit marker gene selection. Benchmarked against MuSiC, DWLS, and BayesPrism, DECONVersation achieved comparable or superior performance across diverse tissues. Performance further improved with tissue-specific fine-tuning.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 DECONVersation，用单细胞基础模型嵌入结合非负最小二乘法，从 bulk RNA-seq 估计细胞类型比例，并在多组织数据上与 MuSiC、DWLS 和 BayesPrism 比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把单细胞基础模型用于 bulk RNA-seq 去卷积，尝试降低批次效应和标记基因选择敏感性；但摘要未给出具体数据规模和效应量，结论主要限于基准比较。
items.abstract_zh: AI 和深度学习已经改变了单细胞转录组学，使无监督注释、轨迹推断和跨数据集整合能够在大规模上进行。在这里，我们提出将 bulk RNA-seq 去卷积作为单细胞基础模型的一项新任务。去卷积利用单细胞参考数据，从 bulk RNA-seq 估计细胞类型比例，可应用于肿瘤微环境分析以及检测组织组成中与疾病相关的变化。然而，现有方法仍容易受到批次效应、个体层面变异和标记基因选择敏感性的影响。我们提出 DECONVersation，利用预训练和微调的单细胞基础模型嵌入，并结合非负最小二乘求解器来估计细胞类型比例。基础模型嵌入对批次效应具有鲁棒性，并隐式编码复杂的基因关系，从而避免显式选择标记基因。与 MuSiC、DWLS 和 BayesPrism 的基准比较显示，DECONVersation 在多种组织中取得了相当或更好的性能。组织特异性微调进一步改善了性能。

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for Cervical Cancer Histopathology in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Systematic Review of Segmentation, Classification Techniques, and Barriers to Deployment
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background and Objective Cervical cancer remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where access to pathology expertise, screening, tissue diagnosis and digital pathology infrastructure is uneven. Histopathological examination remains central to confirming cervical neoplasia, grading lesions and guiding management. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers opportunities to support pathologists by automating image segmentation and classification, but evidence on clinical generalisability and deployment in SSA is fragmented. This systematic review synthesizes AI techniques for cervical histopathology segmentation and classification and examines barriers to translation into routine practice in SSA. Methods A structured systematic evidence synthesis was prepared and reported with reference to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA 2020). Contemporary evidence was identified from PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore and Google Scholar searches and from reference chaining of relevant systematic reviews. Eligible evidence addressed cervical histopathology or closely related cervical image-analysis tasks involving segmentation, feature learning, classification, whole-slide analysis, clinical validation or deployment. The synthesis focused on 49 substantive publications spanning classical image processing, machine learning, CNNs, transfer learning, U-Net-family and other segmentation methods, attention/transformer models, whole-slide analysis, African studies and digital-pathology implementation. Results The evidence shows a transition from thresholding, clustering, watershed, active contours and handcrafted morphological/texture features toward CNN-based segmentation and classification, transfer learning, multiple-instance learning, attention models and transformer/foundation-model approaches. Early studies were frequently based on small, pre-segmented public datasets, whereas newer studies increasingly use histology images and whole-slide images. African evidence remains limited but is expanding. An Ethiopian study used 915 histopathology images and EfficientNetB0, reporting 94.5% test accuracy for cervical cancer classification. A 2026 Rwandan study used 885 patient-level H&E cervical biopsy images and reported EfficientNetB0 accuracy of 0.99 with ROC-AUC 0.99 on a held-out test set. A Ugandan study used 5,966 cervical histopathology images acquired with smartphone-assisted microscopy and DeepLabV3 + with a ResNet34 encoder for 21-feature segmentation, reporting validation mIoU of approximately 75.8% and Dice of approximately 93.1%. Conclusion AI has substantial potential to augment cervical histopathology in SSA, but reported algorithmic performance should not be interpreted as evidence of clinical readiness. The dominant evidence gaps are external validation, prospective evaluation, multi-institutional datasets, standardised staining and imaging, transparent reporting, calibration, explainability, workflow integration and implementation economics. Future research should prioritize locally representative datasets, lightweight and edge-capable models, patient-level validation, human-in-the-loop decision support and implementation studies conducted within African pathology workflows.
items.summary_zh: 预印本系统综述撒哈拉以南非洲宫颈癌组织病理 AI，覆盖49篇实质性出版物、分割与分类方法及部署障碍，并汇总埃塞俄比亚、卢旺达和乌干达数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把算法性能与真实部署条件联系起来，显示局部数据、染色标准化、外部验证和工作流整合仍是关键瓶颈；摘要中的高准确率不能等同于临床准备就绪。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景与目的：宫颈癌仍是撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）发病和死亡的重要原因，当地病理学专业人员、筛查、组织诊断和数字病理基础设施的可及性并不均衡。组织病理学检查仍是确认宫颈肿瘤、进行病变分级和指导管理的核心。人工智能（AI）可以通过自动化图像分割和分类来支持病理学家，但关于其在 SSA 临床环境中可推广性和部署情况的证据仍然零散。本系统综述综合了宫颈组织病理分割和分类的 AI 技术，并考察其在 SSA 常规实践中转化的障碍。方法：我们参照《系统综述和荟萃分析报告规范》（PRISMA 2020）开展并报告结构化系统证据综合。通过检索 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、IEEE Xplore 和 Google Scholar，并追踪相关系统综述的参考文献，识别当代证据。纳入证据涉及宫颈组织病理学或密切相关的宫颈图像分析任务，包括分割、特征学习、分类、全切片分析、临床验证或部署。综合重点覆盖49篇实质性出版物，涉及经典图像处理、机器学习、CNN、迁移学习、U-Net 系列及其他分割方法、注意力/Transformer 模型、全切片分析、非洲研究和数字病理实施。结果：证据显示，研究正从阈值化、聚类、分水岭、主动轮廓以及手工形态学/纹理特征，转向基于 CNN 的分割和分类、迁移学习、多实例学习、注意力模型以及 Transformer/基础模型方法。早期研究常基于规模较小、预先分割的公共数据集，而较新的研究越来越多地使用组织学图像和全切片图像。非洲证据仍然有限，但正在增加。一项埃塞俄比亚研究使用915张组织病理图像和 EfficientNetB0，对宫颈癌分类报告了94.5%的测试准确率。一项 2026 年卢旺达研究使用885张患者级 H&E 宫颈活检图像，在留出的测试集上报告 EfficientNetB0 的准确率为0.99、ROC-AUC 为0.99。一项乌干达研究使用智能手机辅助显微镜获取的5,966张宫颈组织病理图像，并使用带 ResNet34 编码器的 DeepLabV3 + 进行21项特征分割，报告验证集 mIoU 约为75.8%，Dice 约为93.1%。结论：AI 具有增强 SSA 宫颈组织病理学的潜力，但报告的算法性能不应被解释为临床准备就绪的证据。主要证据缺口包括外部验证、前瞻性评价、多机构数据集、染色和成像标准化、透明报告、校准、可解释性、工作流整合和实施经济学。未来研究应优先使用具有当地代表性的数据集、轻量且可在边缘设备运行的模型、患者级验证、人在回路的决策支持，以及在非洲病理学工作流中开展的实施研究。

items.title: Unlocking the Regulatory Genome by ARGUS: An Evidence-Constrained Agentic Framework for Interpreting Single Nucleotide Variants
items.abstract_or_text: Over 90% of disease-associated variants from genome-wide association studies fall in noncoding regulatory regions, yet their functional interpretation remains a central open problem in genomic medicine. Large language models prompted to interpret such variants routinely hallucinate transcription factor (TF) binding changes, fabricate experimental support, and assign biological significance to statistically negligible signals. We present ARGUS (Agentic Regulatory Genomics for an Uncertainty-aware Scientist), which strictly separates deterministic biological computation from LLM-mediated reasoning. ARGUS wraps 458 DNABERT-based TF binding models in a hypothesis-directed investigation loop where a planner selects evidence sources based on current uncertainty, a verifier deterministically interprets each observation, and intermediate results change the investigation path. On variant rs6983267 at the 8q24 cancer risk locus, the same planner produces four divergent trajectories for four TFs. FOXA1 is rescued in 3 steps when real ADASTRA allele-specific binding data (15 experiments, FDR = 0.030) reveals a model false negative masked by saturation. KLF6 traverses 8 steps across ADASTRA, JASPAR motif analysis, and ENCODE cCRE regulatory annotation before abstaining due to mixed indirect evidence. RAD21 abstains in 8 steps after ADASTRA returns a coverage-qualified but nonsignificant allelic test (5 experiments, FDR = 0.65), and SP1, which shares FOXA1's saturated retained prediction, abstains because no direct experimental evidence exists at this locus. All observations come from real ADASTRA, JASPAR, and ENCODE cCRE queries; none are simulated. A comparison of fixed-priority and LLM-mediated planning shows that the LLM planner reaches identical verdicts with fewer tool calls by declining evidence that cannot resolve the claim under test.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 ARGUS，将458个 DNABERT 转录因子结合模型、真实 ADASTRA/JASPAR/ENCODE 证据与不确定性感知代理规划结合，用于单核苷酸变异的证据约束解释。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其价值在于把确定性计算、证据核验和 LLM 推理分开，并允许模型在证据混杂时弃权；示例仅围绕 rs6983267，不能推广为普遍的变异因果判定。
items.abstract_zh: 全基因组关联研究中超过90%的疾病相关变异位于非编码调控区域，但对这些变异进行功能解释仍是基因组医学中的核心开放问题。提示大型语言模型解释此类变异时，常会幻觉式地产生转录因子（TF）结合变化、捏造实验支持，并为统计学上可忽略的信号赋予生物学意义。我们提出 ARGUS（Agentic Regulatory Genomics for an Uncertainty-aware Scientist），严格区分确定性生物学计算与由 LLM 介导的推理。ARGUS 将458个基于 DNABERT 的 TF 结合模型置于假设导向的调查循环中：规划器根据当前不确定性选择证据来源，验证器以确定性方式解释每项观察结果，中间结果会改变后续调查路径。针对 8q24 癌症风险位点的变异 rs6983267，同一个规划器为四个 TF 产生四条不同轨迹。当真实 ADASTRA 等位基因特异性结合数据（15项实验，FDR = 0.030）显示出被饱和效应掩盖的模型假阴性时，FOXA1 在3步内得到挽救。KLF6 在 ADASTRA、JASPAR 基序分析和 ENCODE cCRE 调控注释之间经过8步后，由于间接证据相互混杂而弃权。RAD21 在8步后弃权，因为 ADASTRA 返回了通过覆盖度要求但不显著的等位基因检验结果（5项实验，FDR = 0.65）；SP1 与 FOXA1 共享饱和的保留预测，但由于该位点没有直接实验性证据，也选择弃权。所有观察结果均来自真实的 ADASTRA、JASPAR 和 ENCODE cCRE 查询，没有使用模拟数据。对固定优先级规划和 LLM 介导规划的比较显示，LLM 规划器通过拒绝无法解决当前待检验主张的证据，在更少工具调用下得到相同结论。
items.author_line: Pratik Dutta, Matthew B. Obusan, Max Chao, Rekha Sathian, Nimisha Papineni, Ramana V. Davuluri

items.title: Cross-cohort Mamography]{Representation-dependent domain adaptation for cross-cohort generalization of mammography diagnostic models
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) models for mammography can achieve high diagnostic performance when training and test data originate from similar populations and imaging environments, but performance often deteriorates under cross- cohort domain shift. Differences in acquisition systems, image characteristics, preprocessing, population composition, and disease prevalence can introduce distributional variation that is poorly captured by conventional within- dataset validation. Recent studies have further shown that Foundation Model representations can retain substantial dataset-specific information. However, it remains unclear how image representation influences diagnostic transfer to completely unseen cohorts and whether domain-adversarial learning provides comparable benefits across different representation types. Methods: We systematically evaluated cross-cohort mammography classification using seven independent datasets spanning diverse geographic, institutional, scanner, and imaging environments. Three image representations were compared: handcrafted radiomic features, EfficientNet-B0-derived features, and embeddings from the medical vision-language model MedSigLIP-448. Each was evaluated under three preprocessing conditions: unprocessed images, Otsu-based breast-region extraction, and Otsu extraction combined with Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Patient-level classification was performed using a mean-pooled multilayer perceptron (MLP) baseline and an attention-based Domain-Adversarial Neural Network (DANN). Generalization was evaluated using a multi-source Leave-One-Domain-Out (LODO) framework in which six datasets were used for model development and the seventh was completely withheld as an unseen test cohort, iteratively across all seven datasets. Performance was primarily assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Results: Cross-cohort performance depended strongly on image representation and model architecture. MedSigLIP consistently provided the highest performance on unseen cohorts. With MedSigLIP features, mean LODO AUC-ROC increased from 0.598 with MLP to 0.685 with DANN for unprocessed images, from 0.607 to 0.678 after Otsu preprocessing, and from 0.603 to 0.659 after CLAHE+Otsu preprocessing. When DANN-MLP differences were evaluated across held-out datasets and preprocessing conditions, a significant gain was observed for MedSigLIP after correction for multiple comparisons, whereas corresponding gains were not significant for Radiomics or EfficientNet-B0. A mixed-effects analysis similarly showed a positive MedSigLIP X DANN interaction, although this narrowly missed conventional statistical significance. Unprocessed images produced the highest numerical mean performance for MedSigLIP-DANN, but preprocessing itself had no significant overall effect. Notably, linear probing showed strong dataset discriminability in MedSigLIP and EfficientNet representations but little linearly recoverable dataset information in Radiomics, indicating that low dataset separability alone did not predict better diagnostic generalization. Conclusion: Cross-cohort mammography generalization depends strongly on the choice of image representation and its interaction with the classification strategy. MedSigLIP provided the most transferable representation in our multi-source unseen-domain evaluation, and the performance gain associated with DANN was concentrated in MedSigLIP rather than consistently observed across representation types. These findings suggest that the effectiveness of domain-adversarial learning is representation-dependent and that neither conventional preprocessing nor low dataset discriminability alone ensures robust transfer to unseen clinical cohorts.
items.summary_zh: 预印本在7个独立乳腺摄影数据集上进行跨队列留一域外推，比较 Radiomics、EfficientNet-B0 和 MedSigLIP-448 表征及 DANN 域适应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究直接检验了未见临床队列上的泛化，显示收益依赖表征与分类策略的组合；MedSigLIP-DANN 的平均 LODO AUC-ROC 仍只有0.685，不能视为临床诊断因果或可用性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：当训练和测试数据来自相似人群和成像环境时，乳腺摄影 AI 模型可以达到较高诊断性能，但在跨队列域偏移下性能往往下降。采集系统、图像特征、预处理、人口构成和疾病患病率的差异会造成分布变化，而传统的队列内验证难以充分捕捉这些变化。近期研究还表明，基础模型表征可能保留大量数据集特异性信息。然而，图像表征如何影响向完全未见队列的诊断迁移，以及域对抗学习在不同表征类型上是否具有相当收益，仍不清楚。方法：我们使用7个独立数据集系统评价跨队列乳腺摄影分类，这些数据集覆盖不同地理区域、机构、扫描仪和成像环境。比较三种图像表征：手工设计的影像组学特征、从 EfficientNet-B0 得到的特征，以及医学视觉语言模型 MedSigLIP-448 的嵌入。每种表征均在三种预处理条件下评价：未处理图像、基于 Otsu 的乳房区域提取，以及 Otsu 提取结合限制对比度自适应直方图均衡化（CLAHE）。患者级分类采用平均池化多层感知机（MLP）基线和基于注意力的域对抗神经网络（DANN）。泛化能力通过多源留一域外推（LODO）框架评价：每次用6个数据集进行模型开发，并完全留出第7个数据集作为未见测试队列，依次对7个数据集重复。主要使用 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC-ROC）评价性能。结果：跨队列性能强烈依赖图像表征和模型架构。MedSigLIP 在未见队列上始终提供最高性能。使用 MedSigLIP 特征时，未处理图像的平均 LODO AUC-ROC 从 MLP 的0.598提高到 DANN 的0.685；Otsu 预处理后从0.607提高到0.678；CLAHE+Otsu 预处理后从0.603提高到0.659。当在留出数据集和预处理条件上评价 DANN-MLP 差异时，经过多重比较校正后，MedSigLIP 出现显著增益，而 Radiomics 或 EfficientNet-B0 的相应增益不显著。混合效应分析同样显示 MedSigLIP 与 DANN 的正交互作用，但其显著性略未达到传统标准。未处理图像在 MedSigLIP-DANN 组合下产生最高的数值平均性能，但预处理本身没有显著的总体效应。值得注意的是，线性探测显示 MedSigLIP 和 EfficientNet 表征具有较强的数据集可辨识性，而 Radiomics 中可线性恢复的数据集信息很少，说明较低的数据集可分性本身并不能预测更好的诊断泛化。结论：跨队列乳腺摄影泛化强烈依赖图像表征及其与分类策略的交互。MedSigLIP 在多源未见域评价中提供了最具迁移性的表征，与 DANN 相关的性能增益集中在 MedSigLIP 上，并未一致地出现在所有表征类型中。这些结果表明，域对抗学习的有效性依赖表征类型；传统预处理或较低的数据集可分性本身都不能保证向未见临床队列进行稳健迁移。

items.title: Cross-species representation learning aligns mouse and human neural dynamics and tracks clinical drug efficacy
items.abstract_or_text: Preclinical models poorly predict human drug efficacy, particularly in neurological disorders. Neural activity offers a uniquely rich source of translational information because it captures high-dimensional variation in nervous-system function that can be measured in both animals and humans. However, its high dimensionality makes it difficult to distinguish conserved disease-related features from variation arising from species, recording modality and experimental context. Here, we test whether shared neural dynamics can be identified directly from electrophysiology data by learning representations organized by biological state rather than species. We develop a dual-rule contrastive learning framework that aligns corresponding mouse and human states while preserving separation between distinct phenotypes. This framework recovered conserved sensory-response structure across species and, in epilepsy, resolved distinct relationships between three mouse models and heterogeneous human patient populations. When treated animals were projected into a frozen cross-species representation, drug-induced movement towards the human-aligned healthy state retrospectively tracked known clinical efficacy across ten model-drug combinations including a disease-specific detrimental effect. The framework also identified shared disease-associated neural dynamics between Fmr1-knockout mice and human 16p11.2 copy-number variant carriers despite differences in genetic aetiology and recording modality. Together, these findings show the potential of cross-species neural representation learning to map heterogeneous human disease onto experimentally tractable preclinical states and assess whether interventions restore human-relevant circuit function.
items.summary_zh: 预印本用双规则对比学习对齐小鼠与人类神经动力学，在癫痫和 Fmr1/16p11.2 模型中比较跨物种疾病状态，并回溯评估10种模型—药物组合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了把动物神经活动映射到人类疾病状态的转化建模路径；但药物效能关联是回溯性追踪，不是前瞻性临床疗效或因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 临床前模型对人类药物疗效的预测能力较弱，尤其是在神经系统疾病中。神经活动提供了独特且丰富的转化信息来源，因为它捕捉了可在人类和动物中测量的神经系统功能高维变化。然而，其高维性使得区分保守的疾病相关特征与由物种、记录模态和实验环境造成的变异变得困难。在这里，我们通过学习按生物学状态而非物种组织的表征，检验能否直接从电生理数据中识别共享的神经动力学。我们开发了双规则对比学习框架，对齐对应的小鼠和人类状态，同时保持不同表型之间的分离。该框架恢复了跨物种保守的感觉反应结构；在癫痫研究中，它解析了三个小鼠模型与异质性人类患者群体之间的不同关系。当将接受治疗的动物投影到冻结的跨物种表征中时，药物诱导的向与人类对齐的健康状态移动，在10种模型—药物组合中回溯性追踪了已知的临床疗效，其中包括一种疾病特异性的有害效应。该框架还识别出 Fmr1 敲除小鼠与人类 16p11.2 拷贝数变异携带者之间共享的疾病相关神经动力学，尽管二者的遗传病因和记录模态不同。总体而言，这些结果显示，跨物种神经表征学习有潜力将异质性人类疾病映射到可进行实验操作的临床前状态，并评估干预是否恢复了与人类相关的回路功能。
items.author_line: Marko Tvrdic, Justin Richmond Domingo, Jae Ann Buenaluz, Jydell Ashley Palomo Penollar, Edmayelle Villavicencio Alforja, Jobi Fallaeria Subosa, Gabriel Ocana-Santero

items.title: RAGenome: Scaling Retrieval-Based Genomic Language Models to Long Contexts
items.abstract_or_text: The genome holds the blueprint that governs the biological properties of the cell. Consequently, advancing our knowledge of genomic function is crucial both for a broader understanding of biology and for continued biomedical advances. The success of large language models on natural language and protein sequences has motivated similar efforts on genomic data. However, standard genomic language models (gLMs) often require extremely large computational resources and still fall behind traditional methods on some downstream tasks. Recently, MSA-based pretraining has been proposed as an efficient alternative, but existing models are limited to short input contexts, restricting their use to short-range tasks, such as variant effect prediction. In this work, we present RAGenome, the first retrieval-based gLM that scales pretraining to longer contexts (100\times longer than existing MSA-based gLMs), allowing it to capture both across-species evolutionary relationships and within-species longer-range interactions. Trained on whole-genome alignments from 100 vertebrates, RAGenome substantially improves the long-range capabilities of MSA-based gLMs, raising gene finding performance from 0.45 to 0.60, while remaining competitive on purely evolutionary-based tasks like prioritizing pathogenic variants. RAGenome provides competitive gLM performance at a fraction of the training cost, unifying evolutionary modeling and long-range capabilities within a single, flexible, scalable framework. Code is available at https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 RAGenome，在100种脊椎动物全基因组比对上训练检索式基因组语言模型，将 MSA 上下文扩展到现有模型的100倍，并提升基因寻找性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把跨物种进化关系与物种内长程基因组相互作用放进同一模型，并报告代码公开；但基因寻找从0.45到0.60的提升仍是模型基准结果。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组承载着支配细胞生物学性质的蓝图。因此，推进我们对基因组功能的认识，对于更广泛地理解生物学和持续推进生物医学都至关重要。大型语言模型在自然语言和蛋白质序列上的成功，推动了对基因组数据开展类似工作。然而，标准基因组语言模型（gLM）通常需要极其庞大的计算资源，并且在某些下游任务上仍落后于传统方法。近期，基于 MSA 的预训练被提出作为一种高效替代方案，但现有模型局限于较短输入上下文，限制了其在短程任务（例如变异效应预测）中的应用。在这项工作中，我们提出 RAGenome，这是首个将预训练扩展到更长上下文的检索式 gLM，其上下文长度达到现有基于 MSA 的 gLM 的100倍，使模型能够捕捉跨物种进化关系以及物种内更长程的相互作用。RAGenome 在100种脊椎动物的全基因组比对上训练，显著增强了基于 MSA 的 gLM 的长程能力，使基因寻找性能从0.45提高到0.60，同时在致病变异优先级排序等纯进化任务上保持竞争力。RAGenome 以训练成本的一小部分提供具有竞争力的 gLM 性能，在单一灵活且可扩展的框架中统一了进化建模和长程能力。代码已在 https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome 公开。
items.author_line: Frederikke Isa Marin, Panagiotis Antoniadis, Dionysia Danai Brilli, Andreas Bjerregaard, Rachael DeVries, Yan Li, Ole Winther, Wouter Boomsma

items.title: DrugMiR: A Multi-Source Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network with Adaptive Feature-Embedding Fusion for Predicting miRNA-Mediated Drug Resistance and Sensitivity
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) regulate anticancer drug resistance and sensitivity through their target genes, so predicting miRNA-drug associations offers guidance for personalized therapy. Experimental identification is slow and costly, and existing graph-based predictors leave three needs under-served: generalization to entities unseen at training time and lacking sequence or structural annotation; an inspectable use of the gene-level pathway through which miRNAs act; and preservation of the clinically decisive direction of an effect, resistance versus sensitivity. Methods. DrugMiR pairs a three-channel encoder with a direction-aware prediction head. An adaptive feature-embedding fusion learns, per entity, how far to trust the explicit biological features against a learnable embedding, relying on the embedding alone where annotation is absent. A Gene Bridge channel shapes each entity by the named gene nodes it acts on, using scatter-mean aggregation that needs no metapath enumeration. A dual head scores resistance and sensitivity separately. We evaluate on two benchmarks under five-fold cross-validation with five random seeds against six baselines, and under three inductive settings. Results. DrugMiR reaches a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.9618 and 0.9467 and leads on nine of ten metric-dataset entries. The larger gap opens under inductive evaluation: when both the miRNA and the drug are withheld from training, DrugMiR holds 0.72 and 0.75 and leads the only baseline that stays applicable by 5.4 to 6.7 AUC points. Removing the feature-embedding fusion costs 8.8 AUC points on the feature-incomplete benchmark under this setting, while leaving the fully annotated benchmark within noise. Gene-level attributions single out regulators such as HSF1 and CYP3A4 that connectivity alone ranks in the thousands, and a literature audit finds published support for 32 of the 54 top-ranked predictions. Conclusions. DrugMiR predicts miRNA-mediated drug resistance and sensitivity when biological annotations are incomplete, the regime in which graph-only predictors are weakest; the biological priors, rather than the association graph, carry the prediction there. The Gene Bridge attains this while exposing the individual genes a prediction is routed through, and the dual head recovers the direction of an effect at no cost to either task.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 DrugMiR，用三通道编码器、Gene Bridge 和方向感知预测头预测 miRNA 介导的耐药与敏感方向；在两个基准和归纳设置中评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对训练中未见实体和生物注释不完整的现实场景，同时保留 resistance/sensitivity 方向并提供基因级归因；但结果仍主要来自交叉验证和文献支持审计。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：miRNA 通过其靶基因调控抗癌药物耐药性和敏感性，因此预测 miRNA—药物关联可为个体化治疗提供指导。实验鉴定缓慢且成本高昂，而现有基于图的预测器仍有三项需求未得到充分满足：对训练时未见过且缺少序列或结构注释的实体进行泛化；可检查地利用 miRNA 发挥作用所经过的基因级通路；以及保留具有临床决定意义的效应方向，即耐药还是敏感。方法：DrugMiR 由三通道编码器和方向感知预测头组成。自适应特征—嵌入融合机制按实体学习在多大程度上信任显式生物学特征，而不是可学习嵌入；当注释缺失时，它可以仅依赖嵌入。Gene Bridge 通道利用实体所作用的已命名基因节点，通过 scatter-mean 聚合塑造每个实体，不需要枚举元路径。双头分别对耐药和敏感性进行评分。我们在两个基准上进行五折交叉验证和5个随机种子实验，并与6个基线比较，同时在三种归纳设置下评价。结果：DrugMiR 达到0.9618和0.9467的平均 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC），并在10个“指标—数据集”条目中的9个上领先。在归纳评价中差距进一步扩大：当 miRNA 和药物都被从训练集中留出时，DrugMiR 的 AUC 仍为0.72和0.75，并领先唯一仍适用的基线5.4—6.7个 AUC 点。在该设置下的特征不完整基准中，去除特征—嵌入融合会损失8.8个 AUC 点；而在完全注释的基准中，性能仍处于噪声范围内。基因级归因突出显示 HSF1 和 CYP3A4 等调控因子，尽管仅按连接性排序时它们位于数千名之后；文献审计发现54个排名最高预测中的32个有已发表支持。结论：DrugMiR 能够在生物学注释不完整的情况下预测 miRNA 介导的耐药和敏感性，而这正是仅依赖图的预测器最弱的场景；在该场景中，生物学先验而非关联图承担了主要预测作用。Gene Bridge 在显露预测所经过的单个基因的同时实现了这一点，双头结构恢复了效应方向，并且没有牺牲任一任务的性能。
items.author_line: Cao Y, Ai N, Yuan H, Liang Y

items.title: Sex-aware Cross-tissue Regulatory Transformer Identified Sexually Dimorphic Alzheimer's Disease Risk Loci and Causal Cellular Circuit
items.abstract_or_text: Sex differences in Alzheimer's disease (AD) genetic effects and regulatory contexts remain incompletely resolved. We analyzed 449,335 European-ancestry participants using sex-stratified and genotype-by-sex models and developed STAGE-AD, a Transformer integrating molecular QTLs, epigenomic and single-cell annotations. Sex-stratified analyses identified eight female and three male genome-wide-significant signals provisionally classified as novel. Primary test-set area under the precision-recall curve was 0.895 (95% confidence interval, 0.877-0.912), decreasing to 0.751 under locus hold-out and 0.681 under APOE-region hold-out. Statistical-genetic integration in independent HUNT and MVP cohorts supported 236 genes at 106 loci. Prespecified lifetime-risk assumptions yielded liability-scale SNP heritabilities of 11.42% in females and 9.23% in males. Ablations indicated that female-biased predictions depended on glial annotations and male-biased predictions on endothelial and oligodendrocyte annotations. Eleven candidate variant-gene-tissue-cell-pathology chains were evaluated using multi-omics and neuropathological data from 579 NPAD brain donors. These findings underscore the importance of considering sex-specific genetic architectures in the study of health conditions, including Alzheimer's disease, paving the way for more targeted treatment strategies.
items.summary_zh: 预印本在449,335名欧洲血统参与者中开展性别分层遗传分析，训练整合分子 QTL、表观基因组和单细胞注释的 STAGE-AD Transformer，并在579名脑供体上检验候选变异—基因—组织—细胞—病理链。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把性别特异遗传结构与细胞类型注释结合起来，但 locus hold-out 和 APOE-region hold-out 性能下降，候选链仍是统计遗传与多组学支持，不应直接表述为已证实的因果回路。
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）遗传效应和调控环境中的性别差异仍未得到充分解析。我们分析了449,335名欧洲血统参与者，采用按性别分层的分析和基因型—性别交互模型，并开发了 STAGE-AD：一种整合分子 QTL、表观基因组和单细胞注释的 Transformer。按性别分层的分析识别出8个女性和3个男性的全基因组显著信号，并暂时将其归类为新信号。主要测试集的精确率—召回率曲线下面积为0.895（95%置信区间，0.877—0.912）；在基因座留出设置下下降至0.751，在 APOE 区域留出设置下下降至0.681。独立 HUNT 和 MVP 队列中的统计遗传整合支持106个基因座上的236个基因。预先规定的终生风险假设得到责任尺度 SNP 遗传力：女性为11.42%，男性为9.23%。消融实验表明，女性偏向的预测依赖胶质细胞注释，而男性偏向的预测依赖内皮细胞和少突胶质细胞注释。我们利用来自579名 NPAD 脑供体的多组学和神经病理学数据，对11条候选的“变异—基因—组织—细胞—病理”链进行了评价。这些结果强调，在研究包括健康状况在内的疾病时考虑性别特异性遗传架构的重要性，并为更有针对性的治疗策略提供了可能。
items.author_line: Cheng, Z., Judaprawira, S., Perez, J., Goldstein, A.

items.title: Directed evolution of a thermostable family-A DNA polymerase into a reverse transcriptase for 2'-modified RNA
items.abstract_or_text: RNA-based therapeutics increasingly rely on nuclease-resistant xeno-nucleic acids (XNAs), but engineering polymerases capable of reading and amplifying these non-canonical substrates remains a major challenge. Natural DNA polymerases cannot process C2' sugar modifications, and the complete structural determinants governing this limitation remain poorly understood, limiting rational design strategies. In this study, we apply directed evolution methods to Thermus thermophilus DNA polymerase using a microfluidic implementation of the Compartmentalized Self-Replication (CSR). We identify an engineered variant, termed E5, capable of reverse transcribing C2'-modified RNA, a previously inaccessible activity for this enzyme. Next-generation sequencing allow us to track evolutionary trajectories across nine rounds of evolution. Through an integrated analysis combining statistical methods, protein language models, and crystallographic data, we reveal unknown epistatic networks controlling polymerase function. This large-scale experimental dataset (>196,000 thermostable enzyme variants) provides a robust basis for predicting sequence-to-function relationships, accelerating development of enzymes for aptamer discovery and synthetic biology applications.
items.summary_zh: 预印本通过微流控分区自复制对 Thermus thermophilus family-A DNA polymerase 进行9轮定向进化，筛出可逆转录 C2'-modified RNA 的 E5 变体，并积累超过196,000个酶变体数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是有明确实验读出的蛋白质工程工作，连接定向进化、蛋白质语言模型和晶体学；E5 的应用潜力仍需在更多底物、体系和实际治疗场景中验证。
items.abstract_zh: RNA 疗法越来越依赖具有核酸酶抗性的异源核酸（XNA），但能够读取和扩增这些非经典底物的聚合酶仍难以工程化。天然 DNA 聚合酶无法处理 C2' 糖修饰，而决定这一限制的完整结构因素仍未得到充分理解，从而限制了理性设计策略。在本研究中，我们利用微流控实现的区室化自复制（CSR）对 Thermus thermophilus DNA polymerase 进行定向进化。我们鉴定出一个名为 E5 的工程化变体，能够对 C2'-modified RNA 进行逆转录，这是该酶此前无法实现的活性。随后，下一代测序追踪了9轮进化中的轨迹。通过结合统计方法、蛋白质语言模型和晶体学数据的综合分析，我们揭示了控制聚合酶功能的未知上位性网络。这个大规模实验数据集包含超过196,000个耐热酶变体，为预测序列—功能关系提供了稳健基础，并可加速适配体发现和合成生物学应用。
items.author_line: Vincent, E., Lopez, C., Sieskind, R., Commenge, I., Navaza, R., Haouz, A., Delarue, M.

items.title: Evo2HiC: a multimodal foundation model for integrative analysis of genome sequence and architecture
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding how genome sequences shape three-dimensional (3D) genome architecture is fundamental to interpreting diverse biological processes. Although previous studies have shown that sequence information can predict 3D genome architecture, these models fall short in capturing cell type-specific structures because they are trained solely on sequence inputs. The widely available Hi-C data, which contains rich structural information across biosamples, can provide complementary features to sequence data for studying cell type-specific architectures. Recently, DNA foundation models have demonstrated encouraging performance in capturing long-range genomic dependencies, holding promise for modeling chromatin interactions. However, the extremely high computational cost of running these models limits their applicability to Hi-C analysis, which requires genome-wide sequence embeddings. Here, we present Evo2HiC, a multimodal foundation model that jointly models genome sequences and structures to study cell type-specific chromatin structure. The key idea of Evo2HiC is to distill a large-scale DNA foundation model, Evo 2 (7B), into a compact encoder, while guiding the distillation with Hi-C data to preserve genomic features critical for 3D genome analysis. The model supports two types of encoders, one that operates directly on DNA sequences, and a second that additionally takes as input corresponding Hi-C data. Using the DNA-only encoder and predicting raw Hi-C contact matrices, Evo2HiC improved distance-stratified Spearman correlation by 10.9% over Orca. Moreover, by jointly embedding Hi-C and sequence information Evo2HiC achieved the best overall Pearson correlation when predicting five representative epigenomic assays. Interpretation analysis of Evo2HiC revealed its ability to identify cell type-specific sequence motifs that explain changes in epigenomic signals. Finally, we demonstrated the cross-species generalizability of Evo2HiC on 177 species from the DNA Zoo dataset for Hi-C resolution enhancement. In summary, Evo2HiC is a foundation model that integrates genome sequences and 3D chromatin structure information, substantially reduces computational cost while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy on predicting various epigenomic signals and genome architecture, enables the identification of cell type-specific motifs, and demonstrates robust generalizability across species.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 Evo2HiC，将 Evo 2（7B）DNA 基础模型蒸馏为紧凑编码器并融合 Hi-C，预测细胞类型特异的三维染色质结构及表观基因组信号，并在177个物种上测试泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把序列、三维基因组结构和细胞类型信息统一到一个较低计算成本的模型中，且报告跨物种泛化；摘要未提供完整外部实验验证，结果仍是模型预测性能。
items.abstract_zh: 理解基因组序列如何塑造三维（3D）基因组架构，是解释多种生物过程的基础。既有研究表明，序列信息可以预测3D基因组架构，但这些模型仅使用序列输入进行训练，难以捕捉细胞类型特异的结构。广泛可获得的 Hi-C 数据包含来自不同生物样本的丰富结构信息，可以为序列数据提供互补特征，用于研究细胞类型特异的架构。近期 DNA 基础模型在捕捉长程基因组依赖性方面表现出令人鼓舞的性能，有望用于染色质相互作用建模。然而，运行这些模型的计算成本极高，限制了它们在需要全基因组序列嵌入的 Hi-C 分析中的应用。在这里，我们提出 Evo2HiC，这是一种联合建模基因组序列和结构的多模态基础模型，用于研究细胞类型特异的染色质结构。Evo2HiC 的核心思路是将大规模 DNA 基础模型 Evo 2（7B）蒸馏为紧凑编码器，并利用 Hi-C 数据引导蒸馏，以保留对3D基因组分析至关重要的基因组特征。模型支持两类编码器：一种直接处理 DNA 序列，另一种还接收相应的 Hi-C 数据。使用 DNA-only 编码器预测原始 Hi-C 接触矩阵时，Evo2HiC 将距离分层 Spearman 相关系数相较 Orca 提高了10.9%。在预测5种代表性表观基因组测定时，联合嵌入 Hi-C 与序列的 Evo2HiC 获得了最高的总体 Pearson 相关系数。对 Evo2HiC 的解释分析显示，它能够识别解释表观基因组信号变化的细胞类型特异序列基序。最后，我们在 DNA Zoo 数据集的177个物种上展示了 Evo2HiC 在 Hi-C 分辨率增强任务中的跨物种泛化能力。总之，Evo2HiC 是一种整合基因组序列和3D染色质结构信息的基础模型，在预测多种表观基因组信号和基因组架构时显著降低计算成本，同时保持最先进的准确率，能够识别细胞类型特异基序，并展示出跨物种的稳健泛化能力。
items.author_line: Fang, T., Li, Y., Wang, X., Xiao, Z., Hang, S., Murtaza, G., Yang, J., Xu, H., Jha, A., Noble, W. S., Wang, S.

items.title: Forecasting Alzheimer's disease progression using non-imaging clinical features and XGBoost
items.abstract_or_text: Identifying progressive dementia during its prodromal stage is a challenging yet critical task for healthcare providers. Traditional clinical assessments are often not sensitive enough to detect warning signs of cognitive decline. Machine learning (ML) methods have shown promise in modeling clinical trajectories associated with neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimers disease (AD). Validation of these models forecasting abilities, however, is widely lacking in the literature. To address this gap, we established a longitudinal cohort from the National Alzheimers Coordinating Center (n = 15,727) comprising individuals who were cognitively normal (CN) or had mild cognitive impairment (MCI) at baseline. Cognitive status and clinical observations collected over up to 10 visits were used to train several ML classifiers. We employed the gradient-boosted tree ensemble method XGBoost with a custom feature-engineering pipeline. On non-imputed data, our models achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.9447 [0.9417-0.9476] and PR-AUC of 0.8554 [0.8497-0.8611] for the CN[->]MCI task, and an AUC-ROC of 0.9059 [0.8983-0.9134] and PR-AUC of 0.9214 [0.9156-0.9272] for the MCI[->]AD task. In a lead-time forecasting analysis spanning mean follow-up periods of 56.1 months (range, 9.1-214.1) for CN[->]MCI and 42.7 months (range, 9.1-126.1) for MCI[->]AD, the non-imputed models detected future progression before diagnosis in 29.58% [28.29%-30.87%] of CN[->]MCI progressors and 22.41% [21.36%-23.46%] of MCI[->]AD progressors. Among these individuals, the mean lead time was 33.04 months [32.52-33.56] and 17.95 months [17.71-18.19], respectively. False alarm rates among non-progressors were 12.6% [11.5%-13.7%] and 20.0% [18.4%-21.6%], respectively. These findings suggest that longitudinal machine learning models can identify future cognitive decline before diagnosis, indicating clinical utility for early dementia risk stratification. Author summaryAlzheimers disease (AD) is a progressive and currently incurable neurodegenerative disorder that remains highly difficult to diagnose during its early stages. While modern early-stage dementia research relies on advanced neuroimaging, the high cost of these tests excludes many vulnerable communities. We designed our study to advance scalable, low-cost diagnostic alternatives that can identify individuals at significant risk of cognitive decline, ensuring faster access to emerging therapies. We examined trajectories of cognitive decline in 15,727 adults (mean age = 71.45 years, SD = 9.06) who had between 2 and 10 follow-up visits. Using 37 demographic, behavioral, clinical, and genetic variables, we modeled cognitively stable and declining trajectories using the XGBoost algorithm. Additionally, we evaluated the models ability to forecast future diagnoses and the impact of longitudinal imputation. Our models performed well in both classification tasks (AUC-ROC [≥] 0.90). Imputation did not substantively alter the classifiers performance. In forecasting diagnosis conversion, the models raised alarms before the recorded conversion visit in a subset of progressors, with non-imputed models yielding longer net lead times than imputed models in AD forecasting. This work describes a strategy for handling mixed-length temporal dimensions in longitudinal cohorts and evaluates its prognostic ability.
items.summary_zh: 预印本在 NACC 纵向队列15,727人上用 XGBoost 和37项非影像特征预测 CN→MCI 与 MCI→AD 转化，并报告最长约214个月随访中的提前预警比例。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其规模和纵向设计支持低成本风险分层研究，但仅在单一队列的回顾性数据上建模；提前报警并不等于延缓疾病或改善临床结局。
items.abstract_zh: 在前驱期识别进行性痴呆对医疗服务提供者而言困难但至关重要。传统临床评估通常不足以敏感地发现认知衰退的预警信号。机器学习（ML）方法已显示出建模阿尔茨海默病（AD）等神经退行性疾病临床轨迹的潜力。然而，文献中对这些模型预测能力的验证仍普遍不足。为弥补这一缺口，我们建立了一个来自 National Alzheimer’s Coordinating Center 的纵向队列（n = 15,727），纳入基线认知正常（CN）或轻度认知障碍（MCI）的个体。我们使用最多10次访视收集的认知状态和临床观察结果，训练多个 ML 分类器。我们采用带有自定义特征工程流程的梯度提升树集成方法 XGBoost。在未插补数据上，模型对 CN[→]MCI 任务达到 AUC-ROC 0.9447 [0.9417—0.9476] 和 PR-AUC 0.8554 [0.8497—0.8611]；对 MCI[→]AD 任务达到 AUC-ROC 0.9059 [0.8983—0.9134] 和 PR-AUC 0.9214 [0.9156—0.9272]。在提前量预测分析中，CN[→]MCI 的平均随访期为56.1个月（范围9.1—214.1），MCI[→]AD 为42.7个月（范围9.1—126.1）；未插补模型分别在29.58% [28.29%—30.87%] 的 CN[→]MCI 进展者和22.41% [21.36%—23.46%] 的 MCI[→]AD 进展者被正式诊断前检测到未来进展。在这些个体中，平均提前量分别为33.04个月 [32.52—33.56] 和17.95个月 [17.71—18.19]。非进展者的假警报率分别为12.6% [11.5%—13.7%] 和20.0% [18.4%—21.6%]。这些结果提示，纵向机器学习模型可以在诊断前识别未来认知衰退，说明其可能用于早期痴呆风险分层。作者总结：AD 是一种进行性且目前无法治愈的神经退行性疾病，在早期阶段仍很难诊断。现代早期痴呆研究依赖先进神经影像，但这些检查成本高昂，排除了许多脆弱人群。我们旨在推进可扩展、低成本的诊断替代方案，以识别认知衰退风险显著的人群，从而更快获得新兴疗法。我们研究了15,727名成人的认知衰退轨迹（平均年龄71.45岁，SD = 9.06），这些人接受了2—10次随访。我们使用37项人口学、行为、临床和遗传变量，利用 XGBoost 对认知稳定和衰退轨迹建模。此外，我们评估了模型对未来诊断转化的预测能力以及纵向插补的影响。两个分类任务的模型表现均良好（AUC-ROC [≥] 0.90）。在预测诊断转化时，模型在部分进展者的记录转化访视之前发出警报；在 AD 预测中，未插补模型比插补模型产生更长的净提前量。该研究描述了一种处理纵向队列中不同长度时间维度的策略，并评估了其预后能力。
items.author_line: Gautier, A., Zheng, L., Schreurs, B. G.

items.title: FreeSolvE: Solvent-Mediated Differentiable Pose Refinement and Ultra-Fast Biophysical Inductive Bias for Molecular Generation and Docking
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Deep learning and generative diffusion architectures have revolutionized structural biology and structure-based drug design. However, state-of-the-art models including DiffDock, NeuralPLexer, and AlphaFold3 derivatives exhibit a notorious 'physical plausibility gap,' routinely producing severe steric clashes, bond distortions, and non-physical ligand-protein overlaps. In the official PoseBusters benchmark, leading generative docking models pass fewer than 40% of physical validity checks. Classical molecular dynamics (MD) relaxation is too computationally sluggish (requiring hours per complex) and brittle to rescue these poses at scale. Here, we introduce FreeSolvE , a differentiable continuum solvation and articulated kinematics engine natively optimized for both commodity CPUs and GPUs , designed to bridge statistical generative representations and physical biophysics at ultra-high computational speed . The core conceptual innovation of FreeSolvE is the utilization of implicit aqueous solvation as an ultra-fast thermodynamic mediator : in biological systems, molecular recognition is governed by solvent displacement and dielectric screening rather than gas-phase Coulombic attractions. By coupling an FFT-accelerated Poisson electrostatic solver ( 2.0% to 52.0% (+50.0% absolute gain) in an average runtime of only 2.33 seconds per target (over 18,000× faster than explicit-solvent MD), maintaining 100% pocket residency (mean displacement 0.85 Å) without requiring manual forcefield parameterization, topology preparation, or dedicated GPU hardware. Furthermore, when embedded as an end-to-end differentiable loss layer (FreeSolvEPhysicsLoss) during PyTorch neural network training, FreeSolvE introduces near-zero overhead (+14 ms/step) while completely eliminating pocket clashes within 5 epochs (5 to 0 clashes), whereas standard mean squared error coordinate regression remains permanently trapped in steric collision. FreeSolvE is open-source and installable via PyPI (pip install freesolve), providing a general, ultra-fast, zero-setup biophysical inductive bias for macromolecular deep learning pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 FreeSolvE，将可微连续介电溶剂化、铰接运动学和 FFT 加速 Poisson 求解器嵌入分子生成与对接，以较低计算成本修正物理不合理构象。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把生物物理归纳偏置直接放入可训练损失层，并报告 PoseBusters、运行时间和碰撞消除结果；这些结果仍需独立复现和更广泛复合物验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 深度学习和生成式扩散架构已经改变了结构生物学和基于结构的药物设计。然而，包括 DiffDock、NeuralPLexer 和 AlphaFold3 衍生模型在内的最先进模型存在明显的“物理合理性缺口”，经常产生严重空间冲突、键畸变以及不符合物理的配体—蛋白重叠。在官方 PoseBusters 基准中，领先的生成式对接模型通过的物理有效性检查少于40%。经典分子动力学（MD）弛豫速度过慢（每个复合物需要数小时），并且难以在大规模上修复这些构象。在这里，我们提出 FreeSolvE：一种可微的连续溶剂化和铰接运动学引擎，原生针对普通 CPU 和 GPU 优化，旨在以超高计算速度弥合统计生成表征与物理生物物理学之间的差距。FreeSolvE 的核心概念创新，是利用隐式水相溶剂化作为超快速热力学介质：在生物系统中，分子识别由溶剂置换和介电屏蔽支配，而不是由气相库仑吸引支配。通过将 FFT 加速的 Poisson 静电求解器与……相耦合，FreeSolvE 将某项物理有效性指标从2.0%提高到52.0%（绝对提升 +50.0%），平均每个靶点仅需2.33秒，比显式溶剂 MD 快18,000倍以上；同时保持100%的口袋驻留率（平均位移0.85 Å），不需要手动力场参数化、拓扑准备或专用 GPU 硬件。此外，当 FreeSolvE 作为端到端可微损失层（FreeSolvEPhysicsLoss）嵌入 PyTorch 神经网络训练时，仅增加近乎为零的开销（每步 +14 ms），并在5个 epoch 内完全消除口袋冲突（从5次降至0次）；相比之下，标准均方误差坐标回归始终陷于空间碰撞。FreeSolvE 已开源并可通过 PyPI 安装（pip install freesolve），为大分子深度学习流程提供一种通用、超快速、零设置的生物物理归纳偏置。

items.title: Fine-tuning genomic models on rare splicing events identifies a novel biomarker of TDP-43 pathology
items.abstract_or_text: Genomic foundation models (GFMs) are pretrained on large genomic datasets, but their ability to predict rare disease-associated events after fine-tuning remains unclear. We tested this using TDP-43 cryptic exons, well characterized splicing events linked to neurodegenerative disease that are poorly represented in standard annotations. We compared the state-of-the-art GFM AlphaGenome with OpenSpliceAI, a specialized splice site prediction model. Fine-tuned OpenSpliceAI detected held-out cryptic exons in human and mouse and captured allele-specific splicing effects at the disease-associated UNC13A locus. In contrast, a splicing prediction head trained on AlphaGenome's frozen pretrained backbone failed to predict cryptic exons. Unfreezing and fine-tuning all model weights, however, enabled AlphaGenome to generalize to held-out data. To investigate cryptic splicing in cell types that are difficult to study experimentally, we applied fine-tuned OpenSpliceAI across the genome to study cell type-specific genes. This led to the identification of new cryptic splicing events in CLDN11 and ARHGAP23, which were subsequently validated in FTLD-TDP brain tissue. Notably, the cryptic exon in CLDN11 is predicted to generate a neoepitope that could serve as an oligodendrocyte-specific biomarker of TDP-43 pathology. Our results show that even a state-of-the-art GFM can fail to generalize to rare splicing events, even with substantial pretraining. However, both foundation and specialized models that learn to generalize to rare biological events can have broad applications in biological discovery and medicine.
items.summary_zh: 预印本比较 AlphaGenome 与 OpenSpliceAI 对 TDP-43 隐匿外显子和 UNC13A 等位基因特异性剪接的预测，发现全参数微调后可识别稀有事件，并在 FTLD-TDP 脑组织中验证 CLDN11 事件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了稀有剪接事件的模型泛化和组织验证证据，同时显示大规模预训练并不保证对稀有生物事件有效；CLDN11 新抗原仍是预测性生物标志物候选。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组基础模型（GFM）在大型基因组数据集上预训练，但其在微调后预测罕见疾病相关事件的能力仍不清楚。我们以 TDP-43 隐匿外显子为对象检验这一点；这些剪接事件与神经退行性疾病有关，在标准注释中代表性不足且已有较充分表征。我们比较了最先进的 GFM AlphaGenome 与专门的剪接位点预测模型 OpenSpliceAI。经过微调的 OpenSpliceAI 能够在人和小鼠中检测留出的隐匿外显子，并捕捉疾病相关 UNC13A 位点的等位基因特异性剪接效应。相比之下，在 AlphaGenome 冻结预训练骨干上训练的剪接预测头无法预测隐匿外显子。然而，解冻并微调 AlphaGenome 的全部模型权重后，它能够泛化到留出数据。为了研究难以通过实验研究的细胞类型中的隐匿剪接，我们使用微调后的 OpenSpliceAI 对全基因组进行分析。这一过程识别出 CLDN11 和 ARHGAP23 中新的细胞类型特异性隐匿剪接事件，随后在 FTLD-TDP 脑组织中得到验证。值得注意的是，CLDN11 中的隐匿外显子被预测会产生一种新抗原，可能作为 TDP-43 病理的少突胶质细胞特异性生物标志物。我们的结果表明，即使是最先进的 GFM，在大量预训练之后也可能无法对罕见剪接事件实现泛化。然而，能够学习并泛化到罕见生物事件的基础模型和专门模型，可能在生物学发现和医学中具有广泛应用。
items.author_line: Martin-Linares, C. P., Peethambaran Mallika, A., Sandal, P. S., Martin, T. W., Morris, M., Wong, P. C., Ling, J. P.

items.title: SpatialOmicsLab: an integrated research environment for AI co-scientists in spatial transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial profiling is moving from method development into a central platform for biological discovery and clinical translation, but analyzing such complex data has become the bottleneck of scientific discovery. Translating spatial transcriptomic measurements into biological insight requires reproducible workflows that integrate diverse analytical methods. Although language-model agents can plan and execute multistep analyses, fragmented data and software ecosystems hinder their use as reliable research assistants. In this study, we introduce SpatialOmicsLab, an integrated research environment for spatial transcriptomics comprising 113 curated computational tools, 63 reference datasets and 4,614 task specifications. We also introduce ST-Coscientist, an AI co-scientist that uses this environment to assemble, execute and refine spatial transcriptomic analyses. Within SpatialOmicsLab, ST-Coscientist outperformed expert-led workflows and other scientific agents across six benchmark settings spanning spatial clustering, cell-type deconvolution and spatially variable gene detection. It constructed alignment-aware workflows for three-dimensional MERFISH data and addressed biological questions by selecting and analysing relevant reference datasets. Procedural memory increased the success rate of integrating and validating additional analytical tools from 48% to 95%. Together, SpatialOmicsLab and ST-Coscientist establish an extensible ecosystem for reproducible spatial transcriptomic research, enabling AI co-scientists to address evolving biological questions with an expanding analytical repertoire.
items.summary_zh: 预印本构建 SpatialOmicsLab，整合113个计算工具、63个参考数据集和4,614项任务规格，并用 ST-Coscientist 自动组装和执行空间转录组分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将研究代理放入可复现工具和数据环境，并报告六类基准、三维 MERFISH 工作流和工具验证成功率提升；但“优于专家工作流”的结论仍依赖摘要所述基准设置。
items.abstract_zh: 空间分析正从方法开发阶段进入生物学发现和临床转化的核心平台阶段，但分析这些复杂数据已经成为科学发现的瓶颈。将空间转录组测量转化为生物学洞见，需要整合多种分析方法的可复现工作流。虽然语言模型代理可以规划并执行多步骤分析，但碎片化的数据和软件生态阻碍了它们成为可靠的研究助手。在本研究中，我们介绍 SpatialOmicsLab：一个用于空间转录组学的综合研究环境，其中包含113个经过整理的计算工具、63个参考数据集和4,614项任务规格。我们还介绍 ST-Coscientist，这是一种 AI 科学家，它利用该环境组装、执行和改进空间转录组分析。在 SpatialOmicsLab 中，ST-Coscientist 在六种基准设置下超过专家主导的工作流和其他科学代理，这些设置涵盖空间聚类、细胞类型去卷积和空间变异基因检测。它为三维 MERFISH 数据构建了考虑对齐的工作流，并通过选择和分析相关参考数据集来回答生物学问题。程序记忆使整合并验证额外分析工具的成功率从48%提高到95%。总体而言，SpatialOmicsLab 和 ST-Coscientist 建立了一个可扩展的空间转录组可复现研究生态，使 AI 科学家能够借助不断扩展的分析工具集处理不断变化的生物学问题。
items.author_line: Jiang, Y., Zhan, X., Quan, P., Wang, R., Wu, F., Mi, J., Yao, J., Yao, B., Xiao, G., Shi, W., Xie, Y.

items.title: CBFA2T3-GLIS2 establishes transcriptionally permissive enhancer hypermethylation associated with venetoclax response in pediatric AML
items.abstract_or_text: CBFA2T3-GLIS2 (C/G) defines a high-risk pediatric AML subtype in which de novo enhancer rewiring sustains an aggressive leukemic transcriptional state. The early epigenomic mechanisms reinforcing this program and linking it to leukemic survival remain incompletely defined. Here, we identify enhancer-proximal hypermethylation as a noncanonical, transcription-permissive feature of C/G AML. Using primary C/G-positive AML samples and a developmentally relevant C/G-transformed cord blood hematopoietic stem/progenitor cell model, we integrated DNA methylation, chromatin state, fusion occupancy, and gene expression across early and leukemia-stage contexts. Early C/G-associated hypermethylated regions localized near H3K27ac/H3K4me1-marked active or primed cis-regulatory elements, were enriched for ERG/ETS-like motifs, and showed related architecture in leukemia-stage contexts. DNMT3B was prominently increased in C/G contexts, and its loss selectively altered methylation-associated gene expression without measurably changing global 5mC. Genetic DNMT3B loss increased venetoclax sensitivity in vitro, while pharmacologic DNMT3B inhibition with Nanaomycin-A similarly enhanced venetoclax response. During venetoclax treatment, DNMT3B-deficient xenografts showed reduced disease burden and prolonged survival. To assess whether this interaction extended to clinically used hypomethylating agents, azacitidine or decitabine plus venetoclax induced apoptosis-related transcriptional programs and mitochondrial depolarization. These findings identify hypermethylated active cis-regulatory elements as C/G-associated states linked to transcriptional dysregulation and venetoclax response.
items.summary_zh: 预印本研究儿童 AML 高危 CBFA2T3-GLIS2 亚型的增强子高甲基化，结合原代样本、转化脐血模型、药理抑制和异种移植，观察到 DNMT3B 缺失与 venetoclax 敏感性增加相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究有原代样本、体外遗传/药理扰动和异种移植证据，提示 DNMT3B—增强子状态可能影响 venetoclax 反应；但仍需更多模型、患者样本和临床研究验证。
items.abstract_zh: CBFA2T3-GLIS2（C/G）定义了儿童 AML 的高危亚型，其中从头形成的增强子重构维持了侵袭性白血病转录状态。强化这一程序并将其与白血病细胞存活联系起来的早期表观基因组机制仍未完全明确。在这里，我们将增强子邻近高甲基化识别为 C/G AML 的一种非经典、具有转录许可性的特征。我们使用原代 C/G 阳性 AML 样本以及具有发育相关性的 C/G 转化脐血造血干/祖细胞模型，在早期和白血病阶段背景下整合 DNA 甲基化、染色质状态、融合蛋白占位和基因表达数据。早期 C/G 相关高甲基化区域定位于 H3K27ac/H3K4me1 标记的活性或预备性顺式调控元件附近，富集 ERG/ETS 样基序，并在白血病阶段背景中显示出相关架构。DNMT3B 在 C/G 背景中显著升高；其缺失选择性改变了甲基化相关基因表达，但没有可测量地改变全局5mC。遗传性 DNMT3B 缺失在体外增加了对 venetoclax 的敏感性，而使用 Nanaomycin-A 进行药理性 DNMT3B 抑制同样增强了 venetoclax 反应。在 venetoclax 治疗期间，DNMT3B 缺失的异种移植模型显示疾病负荷降低和生存期延长。为评估这种相互作用是否延伸到临床使用的低甲基化药物，我们发现 azacitidine 或 decitabine 联合 venetoclax 可诱导凋亡相关转录程序和线粒体去极化。这些结果表明，高甲基化的活性顺式调控元件是与 C/G 相关的状态，并与转录失调和 venetoclax 反应相联系。
